# Minimal CITE-seq run

The CITE-seq path expects a list `{$counts, $cell_x_feature}` (sparse
dgCMatrix + metadata data.frame). `unpack_list_citeseq()` returns the
canonical shape.

```{r}
library(scProtXpress)

ref_obj  <- readRDS("data/citeseq_reference.rds")
unpacked <- unpack_list_citeseq(ref_obj)

run_scProteinXpress(
  data             = unpacked$data,
  metadata         = unpacked$metadata,
  dir              = "results_citeseq",
  file.name        = "CITEseq_run",
  modality         = "CITE-seq",
  cell_id_col      = "cell.id",
  cell_type_col    = "cell.type_harmonised",
  dataset_col      = "dataset",
  sample_col       = "sample",
  batch_col        = "batch",
  tissue_default   = "PBMC",
  num.boot.sample  = 1000L,
  num.cells.sample = 100L,
  ncores           = 4L,
  is_transformed   = unpacked$is_transformed,   # NULL => autodetect
  qc_outlier_cells = "auto"                     # CITE-seq => scuttle on
)
```

# External query against a cached reference

```{r}
qobj       <- readRDS("data/citeseq_query.rds")
unpacked_q <- unpack_list_citeseq(qobj)

run_scProteinXpress(
  data             = unpacked_q$data,
  metadata         = unpacked_q$metadata,
  dir              = "results_citeseq/Query_disease",
  file.name        = "disease",
  precBack         = "results_citeseq/Ref_CITEseq_run",
  modality         = "CITE-seq",
  cell_id_col      = "cell.id",
  cell_type_col    = "cell.type_harmonised",
  dataset_col      = "dataset",
  sample_col       = "sample",
  batch_col        = "batch",
  ncores           = 4L,
  is_transformed   = unpacked_q$is_transformed,
  qc_outlier_cells = "auto"
)
```

# `qc_outlier_cells` resolution

The "auto" default reproduces the historical CITE-seq cell-outlier
filter (scuttle::isOutlier on log10 total and detected). Set
`"no"` to skip it (e.g., when running CITE-seq data that was already
filtered upstream); `"yes"` to force it on regardless of modality.

```{r}
run_scProteinXpress(
  data             = unpacked$data,
  metadata         = unpacked$metadata,
  dir              = "results_citeseq",
  file.name        = "CITEseq_no_filter",
  modality         = "CITE-seq",
  qc_outlier_cells = "no",   # skip scuttle
  num.boot.sample  = 1000L,
  ncores           = 4L
)
```
